doc: n5-look iteration 20 (r2_w4 top right: the flame is a hot yellow core under an orange body): the burning ground's fire loop (features/fx/art/fx_fire.png, quest 1's three-ink art: a vermilion body round a cream core) re-inked token by token by tools/art/ground_fire.py into the flame family's colours, written to the weapon FX colour folder as ground_fire.png. FightAreasArt draws it on the FX colour canvas while that canvas is attached; `--ground-fire=ink` = the before (the vermilion and cream loop under the item print). The ink outline and hatching stay ink. No blood red, no teal.
